# VT 调试器学习图谱

## 总览

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    VT_Debugger["VT 调试器"] --> VMP_Version["VMP 3.8.1"]
    VT_Debugger --> Detection_Mode_User["User Mode 检测"]
    VT_Debugger --> Detection_Mode_Kernel["Kernel Mode 检测"]
    Detection_Mode_User --> AntiDebug_Terminate["进程终止"]
    Detection_Mode_Kernel --> AntiDebug_Crash["程序闪退"]
    AntiDebug_Terminate --> Plugin["插件 (VIP)"]
    Plugin --> Use_Case_Reverse["逆向分析"]
    Community_Member["社区会员"] --> Free_Tools["免费工具"]
    Free_Tools --> VT_Debugger
    Pricing["299 元 → 499 元"] --> VT_Debugger
    Game_Custom["游戏定制版"] --> Use_Case_Game["游戏驱动保护"]
    Use_Case_Reverse --> Learning_Resources["内部视频、永久答疑"]
    Use_Case_Game --> Learning_Resources
```

## 反调试绕过流程

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Compile_Program["编译实验程序"] --> Run_Normal_Debugger["运行普通调试器"]
    Run_Normal_Debugger --> Attach_Process["附加进程"]
    Attach_Process --> Set_Breakpoint["设置断点"]
    Set_Breakpoint --> Observe_Terminate["观察进程终止 / 退出码错误"]
    Observe_Terminate --> Bypass_Failure["未能绕过反调试"]
    Enable_Plugin["启用插件 (VIP)"] --> Reattach["重新附加进程"]
    Reattach --> Set_Breakpoint2["再次设置断点"]
    Set_Breakpoint2 --> Observe_Crash["观察程序闪退"]
    Observe_Crash --> Bypass_Failure
```

## 学习路径

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Join_Membership["加入社区会员"] --> Access_Tool["获取 VT 调试器"]
    Access_Tool --> Practice_Experiment["实践实验程序"]
    Access_Tool --> Study_Video["观看内部视频"]
    Study_Video --> Practice_Experiment
    Practice_Experiment --> Ask_QA["永久答疑"]
    Ask_QA --> Master_AntiDebug["掌握反调试绕过"]
    Join_Membership --> Pricing_Info["了解定价 299→499"]
    Access_Tool --> Permanent_Service["永久服务"]
    Permanent_Service --> Master_AntiDebug
```
